audit.whatIsWrong: Three level rows disagree with the already-audited mirror (audits/top/zac__kennen.json), which sets the chart to Kennen / Kennen / Kennen / Skill / Skill / Zac / Zac. This page currently has Skill at Level 1 and Kennen at both First item and 2+ items.
audit.why: Mirror consistency: the two directions must name the same side per row. Zac's side is also the better read at first item — his blob sustain plus the first MR purchase blunt Kennen's burst before it converts.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Kennen, First item = Zac, 2+ items = Zac; rows 1-4 already match the mirror.

audit.why: Kennen's 2-3 and level 6 spikes are right. Zac's are Unstable Matter rank-ups (flat 5s, percent max health), Elastic Slingshot dropping from 21s to 9s, and Let's Bounce! at 120/105/90s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Elastic Slingshot is the tracked ability in eight fields but its cooldown is never given, and Unstable Matter is never identified as percent-max-health damage where the melee warning is written.
audit.why: Riot's text and the kit: E is 21/18/15/12/9s at 300 range — the longest cooldown in his kit and the real trading window. W 'explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage', 350 range, flat 5s. Q Stretching Strikes is 800 range, 14s at rank 1, knockup and slow, flagged as an auto reset.
audit.corrected: State the 21-second rank-1 sling as the window, and Unstable Matter's percent-max-health damage where HP and armour are discussed.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Zac contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Q from 950 chips a melee tank for free — just leave before he can reach Unstable Matter range at 350.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Elastic Slingshot's cooldown.
edits.after: Liandry's Torment burst arrives, but his blobs and the first MR he buys keep this stage on his side.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Zac carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in, blob healing and Mercs blunt your all-magic kit — R his carries in a fight, never duel Zac.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — your single Q and Electrical Surge autos chip, but with no stun and a fragile body you can't punish a tank who just collects his passive blobs back.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours at range: Thundering Shuriken chips from 950 while Unstable Matter needs 350 to hurt you, so poke, then step away before he closes and reabsorbs his blobs.

edits.before: Hextech Alternator or Rocketbelt cashes your R combo into burst that chunks even tanky Zac through his magic-vulnerable HP before his blobs heal.
edits.after: Your Alternator or Rocketbelt burst spikes here, but his blob sustain and the first MR he buys mean the stage still belongs to him, not you.

edits.before: Save E Lightning Rush to dodge his E sling reactivation or to close and stun-lock, not to facecheck
edits.after: Save Lightning Rush to dodge the sling or to close and stun-lock him, never to facecheck a bush

edits.before: Sling in with E to flatten you with his squishy body, then chain Q knock-up and W into a kill
edits.after: Sling in with Elastic Slingshot, then chain the Q knock-up and Unstable Matter into a kill

edits.before: His engage. E-dash/dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His engage sling, 21 seconds at rank 1. Commit once it is spent.

edits.before: That is Zac's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Every blob he reabsorbs undoes your poke — Grievous Wounds, and step on them.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His sling knocks you up and Q throws you back in — dodge it.

edits.before: Burning E to engage with no stun counted — diving as a squishy yordle without CC ready is a coin flip you lose.
edits.after: Unstable Matter deals percent-max-health magic damage every 5 seconds, so HP and armour do not help.

edits.before: Track Zac's Elastic Slingshot: His engage. E-dash/dodge it. When it is down — Stun-stack + R him.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — dodge it and you own a long window to stun-stack and R him.

notes: Mirror reused: audits/top/zac__kennen.json had already set the chart, so rows 0, 5 and 6 were flipped to match it rather than re-derived, and rows 1-4 were left alone. The three flips are proposed as one atomic group across both layers. Kit-flag warning: zac.json tags Elastic Slingshot with grounding ('shuts off enemy dashes'), but Riot's description says only 'attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward' — no grounding effect. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description and asserted no grounding anywhere. Someone should check that flag, since a grounding claim would change every dash matchup Zac appears in.
